products.title: 39" Mid-Century Modern Oval Fluted Coffee Table with Curved Edges

description.plain:
Elegant Fluted Design: This oval coffee table blends mid-century character with a clean, contemporary silhouette. The smoothly curved tabletop is supported by two cylindrical fluted bases, adding texture, depth and a distinctive designer-inspired look to your living room. Its warm wood-grain finish complements modern, farmhouse, boho and minimalist interiors.

Smooth Oval Profile: The gently rounded tabletop edges soften the appearance of surrounding furniture and help reduce the inconvenience of sharp corners. Its elongated oval shape creates an inviting centerpiece while allowing people to move more comfortably around the table.

Compact Size for Smaller Spaces: Measuring 39.38"W × 19.69"D × 13.78"H, this low-profile coffee table offers practical surface space without overwhelming the room. It fits comfortably in apartments, small to medium-sized living rooms, lounges and other spaces where a full-size coffee table may feel too bulky.

Stable Dual-Base Construction: Crafted from engineered wood, the tabletop is supported by two wide fluted cylindrical bases for balanced everyday stability. The spacious surface provides convenient room for beverages, books, remotes and decorative accents while maintaining a streamlined, uncluttered appearance.

Easy to Clean & Assemble: The smooth finished surface can be wiped clean with a soft damp cloth to remove dust and everyday spills. Clearly labeled parts, included hardware and step-by-step instructions help make assembly straightforward. The table is also supported by GIRATREE’s one-year warranty.

Designed with Curves, Texture & Everyday Versatility

products.title: Garvee 31.5 in Round Lift Top Coffee Table with Storage, Fluted Drum Wood Center Table with Hidden Cabinets/Compartments, Modern Farmhouse/Mid-Century for Living Room & Small Spaces - Color: Walnut

description.plain:
Round Lift-Top Coffee Table with Hidden Storage (31.5")

Bring clean mid-century style and everyday practicality to your space with this round coffee table with storage. The fluted farmhouse drum silhouette and natural textured wood-look surface add warmth and character, while the sleek lines blend easily with modern, minimalist, or classic living room decor.

Lift Top Function: The liftable tabletop creates a flexible surface for daily life—use it as a living room tea table, a cozy window-side leisure table, or a convenient work-and-snack spot from the sofa.

Hidden Storage & Cabinets: Keep your space tidy with generous concealed storage inside. It’s ideal for organizing books, throws, cushions, and board games, helping reduce visible clutter in small spaces.

Stable & Safe Design: Built with a sturdy column-style frame and reinforced support legs, this wood center table stays stable and wobble-free for long-term use. Rounded edges help provide a safer, family-friendly feel.

Easy Assembly, Easy Care: Simplified construction with clear instructions makes setup quick and straightforward. The smooth tabletop wipes clean easily for low-maintenance everyday use.

products.title: Eric oak finish coffee table with storage

description.plain: Combining practicality and sophisticated design, this coffee table is ideal for the modern home. The mid-century modern style subtly blends classic aesthetics with contemporary craftsmanship. The table is made of engineered wood with a rich oak finish, which is sturdy and durable. The wood-colored table surface shows the beauty of the natural smooth wood grain. The unique rounded leg design is aesthetically pleasing and provides stable support, and the rounded edges not only enhance aesthetics but also increase safety in use. The two side panels are higher than the tabletop to prevent accidental dropping of items from the tabletop. Every detail reflects fine control of design and a deep understanding of aesthetics. The table features an open space and a large drawer, respectively, providing ample storage space and the ability to display items. This coffee table will warm and elegant your living and family rooms, making it the perfect centerpiece for family and friend gatherings.

products.title: Oak Solid Wood Mid-Century Coffee Table with Shelf, 47.3 in

description.plain:
Light, natural oak with its grain on full display makes this rectangular coffee table feel calm and honest. It is all solid oak, sealed with a non-toxic spray coating that leaves no odor, and the corners are rounded so small children have nothing sharp to run into.

Storage comes on two open levels. The tabletop handles cups, a lamp and the TV remote, while the lower shelf keeps books, baskets and decor visible and reachable from every side. Overall width is 47.3 inches.

There is roughly 8 inches of clearance under the lower tier, so a broom or robot vacuum can get underneath. The manual and hardware make assembly simple, and the wood-grain top needs nothing more than a quick wipe.

Construction: solid oak.

  • Measures 47.3 in W x 22.1 in D x 17.3 in H
  • Weighs 56 lbs
